The festival is structured as a two-day public event featuring food stalls, shopping areas and live musical performances. Scheduled performers include Talha Anjum and Talhah Yunus, also known as the Young Stunners, Shayan Ahmed, Havi and Hamza Khan. A core feature of the festival is the presence of local entrepreneurs, startups, and home-based businesses, many of which are led by women.
